activities.summary: Sourced via amanacapital.com. Confirmed to be a retail forex/CFD trading platform (part of a UK/Cyprus/Dubai/Lebanon group), not a portfolio/fund-management buyer. Disqualified per ICP retail-brokerage criterion; recorded so we do not re-research it.

description: Beirut-established (2010) entity within the Amana Capital Group, an online forex/CFD/commodities retail trading platform group also comprising Amana Financial Services (UK), Amana Financial Services (Dubai), Amana Capital (Cyprus) and TradeCaptain.com. A mobile-first multi-asset retail trading app, not an investment-management or fund-administration platform.

fit.disqualified_reason: Retail forex/CFD trading platform for individual consumer traders, not a portfolio/fund management buyer - matches the ICP's explicit retail-brokerage disqualification criterion.
fit.reasoning: Fit: adjacent segment broker (10, not a priority segment) + Lebanon (15) + single-asset-class-facing retail trading product rather than genuine multi-asset portfolio management (0) + serves retail traders' own accounts, not third-party discretionary/advisory capital (0) + CMA regulated (5) = 30/60. Timing: no relevant trigger (0/25). Access: no named contact sought given the segment mismatch (0/15). Disqualified per ICP: 'a retail brokerage ... wanting a consumer product, not a management platform' - Amana is a retail FX/CFD trading app, not a front-to-back portfolio/fund management buyer. Recorded so we do not re-research it.

name: Amana Capital SAL
